label: Shawl without Collar Band
description: A waistcoat with a smooth, rounded shawl lapel that runs in one continuous curve with no notch or peak. The unbroken roll gives a soft, luxurious, and decidedly formal look, classic on evening and morning-dress waistcoats. It is the signature lapel of dressy double-breasted vests.
